blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has validated alleged “cash houses” identified by dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. that are allegedly owned by his former boss, former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, and his wife, Rowena, according to NBI Director Melvin Matibag. In an interview on Tuesday, Matibag said the bureau established a connection between the Velasco couple and two residences in Valle Verde in Pasig City that Gracioso mentioned in his affidavit detailing his “cash delivery” claims.
